Name: The Gremio's Captain
Author: Rupnan
Description:
[center][quote][b][size=5][color=#980000][size=6][b]The Guild’s Captain: Kaelen[/b][/size][/color][/size][/b][/quote]
[b][color=orange]IMPORTANT NOTICE:[/color][/b] This standalone version is 100% functional, but [b]it will no longer receive updates[/b]. All future content, improvements, and bug fixes will be implemented exclusively in the new unified version:[/center]
[center][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45750]Rupnan's NPC Collection: Heir, Hero, Spirit[/url][/b][/size][/center]
[center]I highly recommend switching to the new version to enjoy the complete and centralized experience.[/center]
[center]
[size=5][b]A veteran of the Iron Hills seeks purpose in the silence of the mountain.[/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][size=5][size=4][b][color=#980000]Character Overview[/color][/b][/size][/size][/b][/center]


[center][b][size=5][size=4][b][b][size=2][size=5][b]Kaelen[/b] is no ordinary adventurer. He is a Captain deployed from Castle Village to ensure the stability of the Pelican Town mines. Disciplined, stoic, and marked by the scars of war, Kaelen brings a mature, military perspective to the Valley. [/size][/size][/b][/b][/size][/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=5]Will you manage to pierce through his steel armor and discover the man hidden behind the rank?[/size][/b][/center]

[list]
[*][b][size=5][b]A New Neighbor with a Past:[/b] A deep-lore NPC tied to the Shadowlands and the military history of the Ferngill Republic.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=5][b]Military Rank System:[/b] As you progress through the mines and earn his trust, Kaelen will grant you official titles, from [i]Forward Sentry[/i] to becoming his [i]Right Hand[/i].[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=5][b]Dynamic Events:[/b] Over 15 story events featuring interactions with Kent, Abigail, the Wizard, Marlon, and Lewis.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=5][b]World[/b][/size][/b][b][size=5][b] Integration:[/b] Unique reactions to the Community Center, the Joja path, and the Skull Cavern.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=5][b]Combat Mentorship:[/b] Receive tactical advice and unique equipment based on your skill level.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list]

[quote][b][size=5][color=#980000][size=4][b]SVE Compatibility & Integration[/b][/size][/color][/size][/b][/quote]


[center][b][size=5][size=4][b][b][size=2][size=5]This mod has been designed with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] in mind:[/size][/size][/b][/b][/size][/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][b][size=5][b]Full SVE Support:[/b] Kaelen recognizes and interacts with locations and lore added by SVE.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=5][b]Castle Village Lore:[/b] Deepens the connection between the Valley and the military forces of Castle Village.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=5][b]Adventurer's Guild Expanded:[/b] Includes specific dialogue and interactions if you have the Guild expanded.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=5][size=4][b][color=#4a90e2]
 [/color][/b][/size][/size][/b]
[quote][b][size=5][color=#980000][size=4][b]Unique Relationships[/b][/size][/color][/size][/b][/quote]


[center][b][size=5][size=4][b][b][size=2][size=5][b][color=#d1d1d1]• Kent:[/color][/b] A profound connection regarding the front lines and a long-overdue message from a mutual old friend.[/size][/size][/b][/b][/size][/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][b][size=5][b][color=#d1d1d1]• Abigail:[/color][/b] A mentorship and optional romance dynamic where rebellion clashes with discipline.[/size][/b][/b][/center]
[center][b][b][size=5][b][color=#d1d1d1]• The Guild:[/color][/b] Kaelen works side-by-side with Marlon, elevating the importance of the Adventurer's Guild in the game.[/size][/b][/b][/center]
[center][b][b][size=5][b][color=#d1d1d1]• Linus:[/color][/b] As the protector of the mountain, Kaelen ensures that no one harasses those who simply seek to live in peace.[/size][/b][/b][/center]

[b][size=5][size=4][b][color=#4a90e2] [/color][/b][/size][/size][/b]
[quote][b][size=5][color=#980000][size=4][b]Items and Rewards[/b][/size][/color][/size][/b][/quote]

[center][b][size=5]Through his quests and friendship, you can obtain:[/size][/b][/center]
[spoiler][list]
Tactical Boots: Military-grade reinforced footwear.[/list][list]
Cyan Spatha: His personal sword, a mountain-forged blade with a permanent frost-like glow.[/list][list]
Guild Supplies: High-quality tonics and survival materials.[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=5][b]Highly Recommended:[/b][/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][b][size=5][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE):[/b] Kaelen's story is most immersive when played alongside SVE lore.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][center][b][size=5][i]Installation:[/i] Unzip the file into your[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=5][b][b]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mariachaaan/mods]mariachaaan[/url][/b] for making it possible for Kaelen to be a marriage candidate by designing his beautiful spouse room![/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#f39c12][size=5][b][color=#f39c12]Mods[/color][size=5][color=#e4e4e7][b] folder and prepare to stand guard.[/b][/color][/size][/b][/size][/color][/center]

[center][b][size=5][size=2]Dialogue design based on the advice of [b]Alejandro Marcos[/b] and character design inspired by [b]Tia[/b].[/size][/size][/b][b][size=5][size=1]Created by Rupnan - 2026[/size][/size][/b][/center]
